context:
Goal: a failed install is never reported as success.
Problem (risk): in install.ps1, a failed skill install sets only $AgentFailed and is never retried, so the script exits 0 (install.ps1 line 821; the exit reads $StillFailed). It bites in copy mode, and install-manifest-prunes.md line 14 put your PC in copy mode on 2026-11-01.
Based on (code): install.ps1, Install-Dir and Resolve-Failures.
Departs from: main exits 0 on a failed skill copy. Option a exits non-zero.

options.gain: A failed skill copy shows as a failure.
options.label: Add skills to Resolve-Failures, in a small fix lane (recommended)
Keep
options.lose: A stale skill on your PC with no warning.

reply: a, 14:41 CST: install.ps1 fails when a skill copy fails, in a small fix lane. Relayed to lane notes-keep-reverify; this closes on its done report.
short: install.ps1: exit non-zero on a failed skill copy
title: Should install.ps1 fail when a skill copy fails?
why: Lane notes-keep-reverify, from kept note install-skill-fail-exits-0. It bites on your PC.
